# Commit checklist — harness-gate (local nudge, CI is gate)
# Every change that touches vault or harness must pass:

# [ ] index.md + log.md updated together (if wiki/ changed) — SPEC.md:3
# [ ] npm run lint — 0 errors (opencode.json + node --check)
# [ ] node scripts/check_vault.js --strict . — 0 errors, 0 suspects (skeleton 0/0 pass)
# [ ] npm test — 0 failures (or no tests yet)
# [ ] Fingerprint drift clean — git diff --name-only <hash> HEAD -- <Monitored: paths> empty
# [ ] No __pycache__ leak — npm pack --dry-run clean
# [ ] AGENTS.md + SPEC.md in sync — AGENTS is constitution (how), SPEC is normative (why)

# Message format:
# type(scope): summary
# - vault: index/log, Raw: citations, drift hash
# - harness: opencode.json, skills, mcp, plugins, scripts
# - docs: SPEC.md, README.md, PLAN.md
